summary: Consume authenticated maintenance observations in criterion mode.
details: Criterion mode forwards the published predecessor manifest instead of silently ignoring it. Fresh-load and target-omission inputs require a complete source 4.2.1 candidate and authenticated current 4.2.0 predecessor custody.

The observation reader selects maintenance record identities, requires ordered complete target coverage, and checks recorded custody and predecessor bindings. Other criteria refuse this option and retain their existing contracts.
Source controls create no successful maintenance criterion, native run or campaign evidence. Actual observations, joined acceptance, sealing and delivery remain pending.
